About Meridian Rings

At Meridian Rings, every piece we create is the result of a passionate commitment to both timeless tradition and contemporary design. Established in bustling Singapore, our atelier began with a singular goal: to offer men a means to express their stories and character through distinctive, finely crafted rings. From humble beginnings in a small studio, we quickly became a trusted name among discerning clients who seek true personalization and lasting quality.

We believe every ring should embody the journey and individuality of its wearer. That’s why we offer one-on-one consultations, giving you the opportunity to share not just your design preferences, but also the personal milestones, values, or dreams you wish to immortalize. Our founder, Samuel Lee, started his journey apprenticing under master goldsmiths, drawing inspiration from Singapore’s rich tapestry of cultures and global influences. Today, our team blends modern technology and traditional techniques—hand-forging, casting, engraving—to ensure each ring is not just a product, but a legacy.

Using only ethically-sourced materials—whether luminous gold, rare hardwoods, or engineered carbon fibre—we guarantee both quality and conscience in every piece. Our craftsmen’s devotion means rigorous attention to detail and uncompromising standards, regardless of whether you select a Classic Band or a completely bespoke creation.

We are proud to have crafted meaningful rings for clients in more than twenty countries, yet we remain deeply rooted in our local community. Singapore’s spirit of innovation and resilience pulses through our designs. When you visit Meridian Rings, in person or online, you become part of a story that bridges generations and cultures.

Our mission is simple: to transform your ideas into tangible artistry you’ll cherish for a lifetime. We’re guided by values of integrity, personal service, and ceaseless curiosity. That’s why each consultation begins with listening, and every design ends with a signature touch uniquely yours. Whether you’re commemorating an engagement, graduation, anniversary, or crafting a ring that celebrates your journey, we’ll make sure it’s worthy of your legacy.

As a small business, every client matters. Our relationships don’t end on delivery—we are always available for resizing, repairs, and will keep your design in our archives should you ever need a replacement. We also believe in supporting the wider community, donating a part of our proceeds each year to youth arts and vocational training initiatives in Singapore.

Over the years, we’ve grown from a two-person team to a tight-knit group of artisans, designers, and guides—each bringing their cultural backgrounds, technical mastery, and artistic vision to the table. We’re united by a belief that beauty is found in the details and that jewelry can be both a personal talisman and a conversation piece.

At Meridian Rings, our vision goes beyond jewelry. We’re here to empower men everywhere to carry their identity, their stories, and their values with them—on their hands, every day.

  • Personalized, one-on-one design consultations – online or in our Singapore atelier
  • Meticulous local craftsmanship and a fusion of global design perspectives
  • Strict use of ethically-sourced premium materials from trusted partners
  • Customer-first approach with aftercare, resizing, and repair
  • Commitment to supporting Singapore’s creative youth and artisan community

Meet the Crafting Team

Samuel Lee

Founder & Lead Designer – A graduate of Singapore’s NAFA, Samuel blends traditional goldsmithing with state-of-the-art digital design. His eye for detail and passion for storytelling drive every new commission at Meridian Rings.

Hannah Tan

Master Craftswoman – With over 18 years in fine jewelry, Hannah’s hands turn raw gold into enduring keepsakes. She ensures every piece meets rigorous, international standards of finish and ethics.

Ashraf Nasir

Client Consultant – The voice behind our client chats, Ashraf guides each customer through the journey, from vision to ring delivery, ensuring no detail is overlooked.

Ring Collections

From the timeless to the bold, discover designs made for you. Each collection is expertly crafted for durability and comfort, whether you seek subtle elegance or an unmistakable statement.

Classic Bands

The essence of timeless design. Our Classic Bands are a tribute to enduring tradition, reimagined for the modern man. Their rounded edges and substantial feel are perfect for daily wear, wedding ceremonies, or as a cherished heirloom. Each band can be tailored in width, metal, and finish—ranging from polished white gold to matte black titanium. Starting from SGD $210.

Signature Inlays

For men who crave distinction. The Signature Inlays collection features rare hardwoods, natural stones, or high-tech carbon fibre inserted by hand into precious metals. Each piece balances innovation with artistry, creating a one-of-a-kind wearable story—be it a slice of reclaimed Singapore Teak or dramatic black meteorite dust. Perfect for marking special life chapters. Starting from SGD $290.

Engraved Favourites

Your memories, made immortal. Custom engravings transform a ring into a living narrative. Choose to inscribe names, milestone dates, a meaningful phrase, or even a symbol that captures your journey. Employing deep-cut or laser techniques, every engraving is designed for both legibility and longevity. The ultimate gift for birthdays, anniversaries, or personal milestones. Starting from SGD $245.

Request a Custom Design

Tailor Your Ring

Your imagination, our craft.
1. Consultation

Begin your journey with a free, zero-obligation chat. Our experienced consultants listen closely to your vision—be it a specific material, inspiration, or a whisper of an idea—and offer thoughtful guidance to refine your concept.

2. Design Selection

Choose from our extensive collection or work collaboratively to design something uniquely yours. Our designers provide sketches, reference images, and professional advice to help you visualize every element before moving forward.

3. Personalized Engraving

Make your ring one-of-a-kind. Opt for laser or hand engravings featuring initials, memorable dates, family crests, personal icons, or messages significant to your life.

4. Crafted by Experts

Every ring is handcrafted in our Singapore studio by seasoned artisans. We meticulously check fit, finish, engraving clarity, and ensure each piece leaves our workshop ready to be cherished for generations.

Start Customizing

How It Works

  1. 1. Share Your Idea
    Complete our streamlined form or schedule a call. Tell us about your dream ring—no detail is too small!
  2. 2. Get a Free Mockup
    Our expert designers create a complimentary digital preview based on your preferences. Along with this, you'll receive a transparent, competitive quote with no hidden costs.
  3. 3. Approve & Pay Securely
    When you’re completely satisfied, confirm the design and pay via our secure, globally trusted payment partner. Your satisfaction is always guaranteed.
  4. 4. Crafting & Delivery
    Our artisans get to work. Your bespoke ring is meticulously crafted and shipped—free, worldwide—with real-time tracking. Most rings arrive in just 2–3 weeks, ready to become part of your life's story.
